                [32m"- `update-ticket --actor <email> --ref <ref> [--subject <text>] [--status <status>] [--tenant <slug>]` → the ticket as that same four-key object after the change; at least one of the three optional values must be supplied. `--tenant` asks for the ticket to be moved to that tenant and must fail with exit 3 whenever it names a tenant other than the ticket's current one.\n"[39m +
